trigger.description: A deterministic large-corpus fixture profile requested by the scale envelope is missing, unreadable, or incompatible with the current schema version. The caller receives a partial envelope instead of fabricated scale posture.
trigger.invocation: Request a fixture-backed ee.scale_envelope.v1 profile whose fixtureProfileId is not present in the fixture registry.

message_contains: fixture profile could not be loaded
expected_emission.repair_contains: Regenerate or restore the fixture profile
expected_emission.repair_string: Regenerate or restore the requested deterministic scale fixture profile, then rerun the scale envelope probe.
